componentChanges.scope: Checked calloc/free ByteArray backing, throwing public constructors and caller migration, allocation-failure/exact-release tests; independent mmap and Array expected-state conformance retained.
Precise LLDT/LTR descriptor validation with supervisor memory access and write-protected TSS busy-bit publication; eight focused methods.

Speculative JIT decode/fetch failures decline before native publication; completed native prefix state survives cold/cached guest fetch faults, without negative-caching incomplete input; six focused methods across both tiers.

heapConstructionHandoff.scratchReferenceScope: The original handoff retains original scratch paths and pre-correction hashes. Every referenced patch/compiler log is copied in this review and mapped by retentionTransformations; the wrapper correction is separately bound.

releaseBuild.runnerRetention: Hash-bound immutable scratch copy; executable payload not vendored.

limitations: P02 remains incomplete. These are bounded source gates and an experimental-host optimized runner build; no physical x86 reference, glibc/systemd boot, sustained stress, full ISA or release qualification is established.

The successful gate reports732 Swift tests, comprising731 passing and1 disabled physical-reference case. XCTest reports11, comprising10 passing and1 optional pinned-boot fixture skip. Run27 did not execute tests.

Run27 is bound to base plus exact overlay: it differs from the run28 comparison commit in the JIT implementation and allocating test wrapper, and lacks the new decode-boundary test file. It must not be relabeled as the complete run28 source.
Recoverable heap construction does not make Array-returning diagnostic snapshots, read copies or unrelated Swift metadata allocation failure recoverable. mmap remains an independent implementation.
Ignored generated FFI inputs and the copied optimized executable are hash-bound without vendoring executable payloads. No capability bits or completion checkboxes are promoted.
Probe8 architectural state and counters describe the last completed runner quantum if an error interrupts machine.run; they are not necessarily the exact fault state.

guestProbe8.observationScope: Last runner slice exits; guest-handled exceptions are not sampled. Timeout state is the last completed slice.
